component.name: Kobold
component.summary: Synchronize Komga books with a Kobo e-reader

description.p: Kobold copies books from a Komga server, and from folders of your own, to Kobo e-readers connected over USB. EPUB books are converted to KEPUB, comics (CBZ, CBR) to fixed-layout KEPUB sized for each Kobo model, and reading progress is sent back to Komga.

ul.li: Browse libraries, series, collections and read lists with covers
Choose books, or follow whole series, for each Kobo
Sync one or every connected Kobo, with a preview of the changes
Shelves: folders of books outside Komga, with metadata you can edit or find online
Manage the books on a Kobo: hide, show, delete, with backups and undo
Parental control with a PIN, and Komga's own Kobo sync set up in one click
Sync Komga books, local files and shelves to Kobo e-readers over USB
EPUB to KEPUB with kepubify, comics to KEPUB with Kindle Comic Converter
Reading progress sent back to Komga; Komga's Kobo sync installed in one click
Shelves with manual and online metadata, covers, export and import
Manage the books on a Kobo, with backups, history and undo
Parental control, mount and eject, English and French
